string.label: MonitorMode
string.desc: R step monitor -- IGNORED, no R step in either driver

int.label: CoarsenRule
int.desc: Coarsening rule: 1=GARU, 2=PUCA, 3=BULK -- IGNORED for lrfitting, no LR unrefine

int.label: MaxLevel
int.desc: Maximum THB refinement level -- IGNORED for lrfitting

int.label: MaxRefIt
int.desc: Inner adapt iterations per H step

int.label: DirSkip
int.desc: Skip D steps in the first DirSkip cycles

real.label: CoarsenParam
real.desc: Coarsening rule parameter -- IGNORED for lrfitting, idem

real.label: Smoothing
real.desc: R step: Winslow smoothing theta -- IGNORED, no R step in either driver

real.label: Penalty
real.desc: R-step Winslow fold penalty -- IGNORED, no R step in either driver

real.label: Target
real.desc: Error band: absolute rmse target (<0 disables the band); overridden per run by --target

real.label: NoCoarsenBelow
real.desc: Error band: below this rmse, hold; auto-derived from --target as Target/Band^2

real.label: BarrierEps
real.desc: D-step fold barrier: det J_sigma floor

real.label: quA
real.desc: Quadrature: degree factor (projection) -- IGNORED for lrfitting, no projection path

int.label: quB
int.desc: Quadrature: extra nodes (projection and D-step barrier)

bool.label: Coarsen
bool.desc: Enable coarsening in the H step; overridden per run by --coarsen -- IGNORED/rejected for lrfitting

bool.label: Admissible
bool.desc: Keep the hierarchy admissible -- IGNORED for lrfitting

bool.label: Extension
bool.desc: Extend marked element regions -- IGNORED for lrfitting

bool.label: Slide
bool.desc: Boundary controls of sigma slide along the boundary

bool.label: SameElement
bool.desc: Quadrature: assume points share an element (must be false under a composition) -- IGNORED for lrfitting
